description: Sends one of the saved emails of a webinar to an address you name, so you see the real mail in your own inbox, with the real sender, subject, images and footer. Take it before a launch and after any text change: "Send me the reminder once more, I want to see it on my phone." It needs the session and the webinar, and you choose which email goes, the confirmation or one of the five reminders. The recipient is your own address unless you name another. This sends a real email from your site, and nothing on the campaign changes. If you only want to know whether mails arrive at all, there is a separate check. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: test email, send myself the email, check confirmation mail, preview email, reminder test

email.description: The recipient address. Leave it out and the mail goes to the signed-in host.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

which.description: Which email to send. Default confirmation.

name: wi_send_webinar_test_email
title: Send one webinar email to a real address
